title: Compliance Term and Remind before expiry are in months
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. The Add service form open with "Is this a compliance inspection?" turned on, Type "CVIP".
custom_steps:
1. Open the Term list and read its range; try to save the service without a Term.
  2. Choose Term 12 months and read Remind before expiry; then choose Term 24 months and read it again; change it to 3 months.
  3. Choose Term 6 months and set Remind before expiry to 8 months.
  4. Add two compliance services with the same Type "CVIP" (name one "CVIP bus", Term 6 months; the other "CVIP tractor", Term 12 months).
  5. Hover the (i) beside Term and the (i) beside Remind before expiry.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Term is chosen from a list of months, 1 to 60, and is required: the service cannot be saved without it.
  • Remind before expiry defaults to 1 month for the 12-month term and to 2 months for the 24-month term, and can be changed (3 months is accepted).
  • The 8-month value is refused inline with "Remind before expiry cannot be longer than the 6-month term".
  • Both services save: the same type can carry different terms (6 and 12 months), and choosing a type fills in nothing.
  • On the design the Term (i) reads "1 to 60 months." and the Remind before expiry (i) reads "How far ahead of expiry the service starts to read due soon. It cannot be longer than the term."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10560 (S3, Add a compliance inspection service), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S3 (Term and Remind before expiry; S3-R6, S3-R7, S3-R8, S3-E2); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard R6 and artboards K01, K02; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R7: “Term will be in months, from 1 to 60, selected from a list, and is required. A compliance service without a term cannot produce a due date”
  • S3-R8: “It is in months, defaults to 1 month for a term up to 12 months and 2 months above that, and can be changed”
  • S3-R8: “It cannot be longer than the term; a longer value is refused inline: Remind before expiry cannot be longer than the 6-month term”
  • S3-E2: “A bus and a tractor may carry the same type with different terms, 6 and 12 months”
  • S3-R6: “The term is chosen on its own. The type fills in nothing”
  • Design board, artboards K01 and K02 (Term (i)): “1 to 60 months.”
  • Design board, artboards K01 and K02 (Remind before expiry (i)): “How far ahead of expiry the service starts to read due soon. It cannot be longer than the term.”
